title: Cybernetic Human
paragraphs: It’s been a few days since Ren and Itsuki came back. We’re helping to rebuild the ruins of the village of Melromarc, which is Big Sister’s hometown. Father said he wanted to rebuild this place, so we decided to pitch in. Ren and Itsuki are here too.

Apparently, she says Faubrey is luxurious but unsettling. She says it’s exhausting having to deal with the Pig King and conduct diplomacy with leaders from various countries, and that she feels more at ease being with us—the ones who’ve worked hard alongside her all this time.
This happened during a break from the reconstruction work. Father is skillfully preparing a meal.
“Even though the wave’s over… I wonder what we’re doing here.”
“Sasa-chan, it can’t be helped. Your Big Sisters are Naofumi-chan’s wives, you know!”
Gasp! My Big Sister’s Big Sister is chatting with the Pandas a little ways off.
“Hehehe… Dark Holy Hero. Your heart is yearning to awaken. Don’t hide in your shell in that bizarre outfit—set your heart free.”
Black Thunder is repeatedly trying to recruit Ren, who’s dressed in a mysteriously tacky outfit.
“I’m done with that kind of thing. Please stop with the weird recruitment pitches…”
“It’ll be interesting once you awaken, so in a way, it’s worth watching.”
“Gaelion-chan…”
“It’s not such a bad deal, you know. That Sword Hero from the loop seemed to have a weapon with better performance than the one in the first world—Wild Naofumi’s world.”
“Why?”
“Isn’t it just the sword spirit’s preferences or compatibility? I think it’s something like the misalignment being resolved when you awaken, causing them to click and the sword to awaken too.”
“Ugh… I’ve never resented becoming the Sword Hero this much before.”
“That’s right. Keep it up… Dark Holy Hero.”
Black Thunder is really pushing Ren hard. He must absolutely love exchanges like this.
“I suppose the fact that you have to use that accursed power is what makes it so thrilling.”
“What am I supposed to do?!”
“Isn’t that just your fate—having been summoned as the Sword Hero?”
“Itsuki, if you don’t cut it out, I’m going to take those headphones off!”
As Ren reaches out to pull Itsuki’s headphones off—just as he’s about to remove them—Itsuki, who had almost slipped into a look of ecstasy, quickly presses the headphones back against his ears.
“Ah… ah… please stop!”
Fleon-chan is in a great mood, singing in the village that’s currently being rebuilt.
“I really wish Fleon-san would stop singing right now, too. Your singing resonates deep in my brain, making me hear things that aren’t there and driving me crazy.”

Apparently, the headphones Itsuki is wearing are designed to block out as much sound as possible outside a specific frequency range. It seems she had her Doctor at the Faubrey Research Institute rush to make them.
“So… since we’re here, why don’t you tell me some stories from your travels? There’s still a lot I haven’t heard yet.”
Ren is asking me and my Rival all sorts of questions.
“What do you want to know first? The story of the first world for the Spear Hero, maybe?”
“Hmm… It might be good to hear about what happened after we broke out of the loop, as it relates to what’s coming next. Or… maybe the story of me in the first world.”

“You’re the Sword Hero? From what Gaelion heard, when the Spear Hero was defeated once and the loop started, he got hit by an attack from the mastermind behind the Waves alongside Wild Naofumi and returned to his original world once.”
“I see…”
“What about me?”
“The Bow Hero was spared because the mastermind saw him as a plaything, and he put up a good fight alongside the Trash until Wild Naofumi and the others returned.”
“So Ren got taken down in a humiliating way, and I’m the only one left… I don’t mind that at all.”
“That’s why, Itsuki…”
Ren is shooting Itsuki a fierce glare. Is the battle about to start? If they really start fighting among themselves for real, it’ll be total destruction… no, I think I’ll step in to stop it.
“Itsuki’s aim is as consistent as ever.”

“Back then, even though it was only a short time here, apparently two years had passed in the Sword Hero’s world. That’s why he’d grown a bit taller. Even Gaelion didn’t recognize him at first glance.”
“Is that so… two years… that means he’s older than Itsuki. Maybe it’s a good thing I’m no longer the youngest.”
“Though he’s different from Ren now, of course.”
By the way, regarding the weapon rewards for this loop, it seems both Ren and Itsuki wanted to stay.
“The Sword Hero from the first world was an incredible swordsman. It felt like he’d spent those two years pushing himself to the absolute limit.”
“That’s kind of cool. It must’ve been like Ren shedding his naivety or becoming the true protagonist or something like that.”

“Ah, as a reward for bringing about the peace the Weapon proposed, the Sword Hero requested the right to travel back and forth to another world several times. If I recall correctly… he disappeared a few times, but he always came back.”
“Travel back and forth?”
“Yeah. Apparently, even though he’d gone to another world during those two years and things still ended on a sour note, he wanted another chance.”
Itsuki and my Father are looking at Ren.
“So it feels like Ren’s adventure was still going on. I’d kind of like to see that as a story.”
“The Dark Saint Hero’s Adventure Chronicle <DARK Brave Chronicle>!”
“Don’t just use people as material without permission. And you—don’t just barge into the conversation!”
Ren pushes aside Black Thunder, who had butted in. Black Thunder seems to be having quite a bit of fun, though.
“Come to think of it, aren’t I saying something to Gaelion right now?”
“You didn’t talk much, like the Spear Hero.”
“A man who speaks with his back… You’re such a pain, as always. Because you’re hiding things, it causes trouble for this other side of me.”
“Itsuki…”
Suddenly, Ren and Itsuki glare at each other as if they were playing kabaddi.
“Does Motoyasu know anything?”
“I don’t really talk to Ren much… All I’ve heard is that he almost rang a single bell on Christmas.”
“Still a loner even after peace has come? You should give up on Eclair and Wyndia.”
“Cut it out already, Itsuki!”
Ren looks like he’s about to snap.
“I’ve got someone too! As long as she’s here, that’s enough. I’d been putting it off, but going back sounds good! Though… I don’t know if I can actually go back.”
“Come to think of it, Ren… didn’t you come to this world after dying while saving your childhood friend?”
“Ah…”
Rival looked away, sounding a bit evasive. Is there something going on?
“What?! What happened to her?!”
“First off, your childhood friend is weird. Giving ten times the Valentine’s Day gift in return is just plain weird.”
“What’s so weird about that?”
“No, it’s weird, right?”
My Father immediately chimed in, catching Ren off guard—who hadn’t seemed to have any doubts.
“Yeah. That’s weird. At most, a negative metaphor for women would be three times, right? Ten times… that’s on the level of ‘I won’t accept it because I don’t want to give anything back.’”
“I wonder if someone taught him that mistaken common sense and kept him in the dark?”
“Plus, after she went back to her original world, she mentioned something about going to some other world with him, getting a boyfriend there, and apparently settling down for good.”
“No way!”

Ren turned his back on us and shouted, then slumped to the ground, resting his hands on the ground. What’s your childhood friend’s name, anyway? I don’t think I’ve ever heard it. She’s definitely a pig! I heard her mom is like that, too. Honestly, I feel sorry for Ren.
“Well, in the first, Wild Naofumi’s world, the Sword Hero had Eclair and his older sister, so I didn’t really pay it much mind.”
“So Ren-san is paying the price for that, huh? I get it. Ren-san, why don’t you just find a girlfriend—anyone will do? Look, there’s that black-haired kid right there.”
“This guy’s a guy!”
“No thanks on the romance front.”
“And he even turned me down! What happened to the Jet-Black Twin Fangs!?”

Ren and Black Thunder aren’t getting along very well, are they? How can they get along as well as they did in that loop? I’ll have to think about that next time. Still, Ren is full of energy in this loop.
“I understand about Ren’s love life, but is there anything else? Mainly regarding Awakening. There are some parts I don’t quite get.”
“You’re still going on about this?! Give it a rest already!”

“Hmm… Then there’s the loop where Naofumi got together with Gaelion—in that one, the Sword Hero had Filolial factors injected into his body by Takt, resulting in Filolial elements in his limbs and wings growing from his back.”
Renn flinched at the mention of his Rival, froze in his tracks, and looked like he was deep in thought.
“Wings of Darkness—that’s cool.”
Black Thunder says.
“A cyborg—that’s cool!”
Fleon-chan seems to agree as well.
“You two, shut up.”
Ren scolds them, but his voice is weak.
“Takt stole your Holy Weapon and captured you alive… That’s tragic. By the way, what about me…?”
“It’s a continuation of the world where I died and the loop restarted.”
“I see… It does seem like a world where you’d die easily. So, Ren, are you interested in having wings on your back? It’s just like the Filolials, after all.”
“Shut up! What happened after that? Did I die?”

“Fortunately, we managed to defeat Takt and rescue you. After that, we were supposed to perform surgery to remove your Filolial elements, but the Sword Hero kept putting it off—and ended up striking a pose in front of the mirror. I remember Fumi seeing that and being impressed by how cool you looked.”
“You really took to it, didn’t you? The cyborg route… It’s a shame that’s not an option now that you have the sword.”
Ren is clenching his fist. It’s trembling.
“The most tragic one for the Sword and Bow Heroes was the loop we went through while the Spear Hero was reduced to a shell of a person.”
As if not caring at all about Ren’s state, Rival crosses his arms and continues speaking.
“The most tragic…?”
“If we’re talking about the Sword and Bow Heroes in this loop… it’s the loop right before this one.”
“Ah… That’s the loop where Ren and I acted selfishly and things spiraled out of control, isn’t it?”
“That’s the one where they say all four spirits—like the Spirit Tortoise—were revived. We were the ones who pulled the trigger on that…”
“It’s tragic, isn’t it… that the Heroes, who were supposed to save the people, ended up leading the world to near-total destruction…”
“Exactly.”

Ah… I vaguely remember it now. It was the loop where Sakura-chan acted so mature. Back then, I was so terrified of Filo-tan that I ended up doing whatever my Rival told me to do. My father was very worried about it.

“The Bow Hero was persistently incited and hounded by his former comrades, forcing him to live on the run across the world. Although Naofumi and the others took him in and the commotion eventually subsided, he was crushed by guilt and died of illness within a few years.”
Itsuki is listening silently, closing his eyes as if paying silent tribute to the end of his other-world self.

“The Sword Hero, while fending off the sparks of trouble that flew his way, gradually stained his hands with blood and transformed into the King of Thieves… and then a mass murderer. As a result, right before Naofumi and the others’ eyes, the Sacred Sword of the Sword Hero turned its back on him, and the sword slipped from his grasp.”
“A-and what happened after that? I’m pretty sure that ‘I’… is the one who said terrible things to Wyndia, right?”

“His personality had already been crushed and shattered by the weight of responsibility, making it impossible for him to live in the human world. So my big sister and Gaelion joined forces to cast a dragon transformation curse on him and give him a new life. To the outside world, they made it look like the Sword Hero had been defeated.”
“…Dragon transformation.”

“I remember how he lost his memories and my big sister raised him as a dragon, and how he grew into a magnificent dragon. Of course, Gaelion knew that he was gradually regaining his memories along the way. By that time, I had regained my composure.”
“That version of Wyndia from that cycle is quite merciful, isn’t she? Even though he was her parents’ killer.”
“Basically, she forgives. That’s what makes my big sister so amazing.”
“Dragon transformation…”
Ren… has a rather puzzled look on his face. What kind of emotion is that?
“Ren-san, I can tell you’re thinking she’s kind of cool right now.”
“Shut up! I know all the dragons in this world are perverts! There’s no way I’d want to become one of them!”
I see, so that’s the look on his face. I’m starting to understand Ren a bit better.
“Haven’t you been saying some rather rude things about Dad and Gaelion?”
The Assistant, who had been talking to the Mole over there, is coming over.
“Wyndia, don’t you get it? The strange thing about your sister…”
“…N-no, that’s not true.”
“Can you say that while looking me in the eye, Wyndia? Don’t look away!”
“H-h-have I ever lied!?”
“Oh, come on—it’s great to see you two getting along so well.”
The Rival is brushing off the insults like water off a duck’s back.
“Still, this loop is a very important one—it’s when Gaelion first met Naofumi and was saved by him. I’m sorry to the Sword Hero and Bow Hero, but it’s a crucial loop.”
“I see… So peace was achieved in the end. In that case, there’s still hope.”
“That’s right. Unfortunately, the Sword Hero and Bow Hero were erased as heroes, but that’s just how that loop went.”
“Ren-san goes through quite a few changes, doesn’t he? It seems like the Ren-san from that ‘first world’ is older than me.”

“Oh, come to think of it, in the first world of Wild Naofumi, when the Sword Hero was sparring with the Panda that came to visit, he mentioned that he understood a bear’s body well. Also, since he was teaching the village Demi-Humans how to transform into Beastmen, Gaelion thinks he must have had some experience with it.”
“I’m actually pretty serious about wanting to know more about Ren-san’s adventures. Putting the pieces together, wasn’t he able to shapeshift into a Beastman in that first world?”
“I don’t know! But… if he’d been caught up in it too… it might be possible.”
